name: Mettle of Man

description.content: After you take [3] protection hits, the next hit that would down you is ignored.
When you become healthy, while you are at least [16m] from the Killer, they see your Aura.
When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.

quote: "Evil has a bullseye on my back the size of Tiger Stadium." -Ash Williams
